bugs.error_message: Bootstrap/Tailwind styling not loading on @vite pages (dashboard, login, etc.); pages render unstyled. Assets requested from http://[::1]:5173/ that never load.
bugs.root_cause: A stale public/hot file was left behind from a previous Vite dev server run (likely crashed or stopped without cleanup). Laravel checks for this file to decide whether to point @vite at the dev server or the built manifest. With the file present but Vite not running, every @vite page referenced missing assets on :5173, so Bootstrap never loaded. The welcome page worked only because it uses an inline <style> block instead of @vite.
bugs.fix: Removed the stale public/hot file. Laravel now falls back to public/build/manifest.json (built assets include Bootstrap 5.3 CSS + JS and Tailwind). To develop with hot reload, run `npm run dev` (it recreates public/hot); when done, stopping Vite cleanly removes it.

bugs.error_message: Render deploy failed during startup with 'Database connection [SQLite] not configured.' after php artisan config:cache and php artisan migrate --force.
bugs.root_cause: The application read DB_CONNECTION directly from the environment, and the deploy environment could supply SQLite with mixed or uppercase casing. Laravel connection keys are case-sensitive, so 'SQLite' did not match the configured 'sqlite' connection.
bugs.fix: Normalized DB_CONNECTION with strtolower() in config/database.php and config/queue.php so related config consumers resolve to the actual sqlite connection key before config caching and migration.

bugs.error_message: Dashboard could not be accessed because the admin user was missing or unverified in the users table, so there was no login to add data through the UI.
bugs.root_cause: The admin seeder existed but was not part of the deploy startup flow, and the dashboard route requires a verified authenticated user. A reset SQLite database could therefore boot without any usable dashboard account.
bugs.fix: Made AdminSeeder idempotent, ensured it creates a verified admin user, wired DatabaseSeeder to call it, and updated the container startup command to run migrations with --seed.

bugs.error_message: Uploaded images did not render correctly from the dashboard after manual uploads on Render.
bugs.root_cause: Image upload paths mixed `public/...` storage prefixes with URL generation expectations, and container boot did not guarantee the public/storage symlink required to serve uploaded files.
bugs.fix: Stored uploads on the `public` disk as `images/...`, added backward-compatible URL generation for legacy `public/...` paths, and updated container startup to create the storage symlink only when missing.

bugs.error_message: Images still did not display after upload despite normalized storage paths.
bugs.root_cause: Serving files via direct /storage URL depended on runtime filesystem link/web-server mapping, which can still fail in some Render container states.
bugs.fix: Added a dedicated image file route (`imagesview.file`) and controller method to stream files directly from storage/app/public (with fallback to public path), then switched model image URLs to this route.
